zh.title: 俄羅斯軍事法院裁定羈押空天軍副司令格列霍夫
zh.summary: 俄媒引述法院紀錄指出，負責裝備的空天軍副司令格列霍夫遭羈押。俄媒稱案件涉及收賄指控。
body: 俄羅斯《生意人報》查閱法院紀錄後報導，莫斯科第235衛戍軍事法院11月25日批准調查人員的聲請，裁定羈押俄羅斯空天軍負責裝備的副司令格列霍夫。
該報引述消息人士稱，格列霍夫面臨收賄指控。AeroTime 報導，格列霍夫否認指控。俄媒尚未交代據稱涉案的金額或與哪一項採購有關。

en.title: Russian military court orders detention of Aerospace Forces deputy chief Grekhov
en.summary: Russian media said a Moscow court ordered the deputy chief responsible for armaments held in connection with a bribery allegation.
body: Kommersant reported that Moscow’s 235th Garrison Military Court granted investigators’ request to hold Yuri Grekhov in pretrial detention on November 25. He is the Russian Aerospace Forces deputy commander-in-chief responsible for armaments.

The newspaper cited sources who said the case concerns alleged bribery. AeroTime reported that Grekhov denies the charge. The reports did not identify an alleged payment amount or link the case to a specific procurement contract.

facts.claim: Russian media said a Moscow court ordered the deputy chief responsible for armaments held in connection with a bribery allegation.
